Infinite Magicraid Echoes

All 138 Echoes with their main stat and full effect at max level. 63 of them have a faction requirement: part of their effect only works if the hero is from that faction.

Accurate Shooter

LegendMain stat: Crit DMG
Nameless Brotherhood

If the owner's initial Crit DMG is over 200%, 18% of the exceed amount will be converted to the owner's Effect Hit, up to 36% can be increased this way. If the owner is from the Nameless Brotherhood, also increases the owner's Basic Attack DMG dealt by 100% of the Effect Hit increased above; besides, when dealing Crit DMG to the Boss or enemies under control effects, this Crit DMG also has 60% Piercing Rate.
